title: Onboard Equinox-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds Equinox-13B v1.0 to the model registry with canonical metadata, initial performance profiles for common deployment targets, and automated changelog/release-note generation for model onboarding. Motivation: Equinox-13B is a high-value open model our customers requested; we want consistent perf metadata and automated release notes so infra and product teams can consume this model reliably. This patch includes: metadata JSON (sizes, tokenizer, supported precisions, recommended quantization), performance profiles for A100 and T4 inference targets, a small config for automatic changelog entry generation, and a registry migration that marks the model as available in the catalog. The PR includes bench runs, unit checks, and a changelog snapshot. No breaking API changes to registry clients.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) add equinox v1.0 metadata and manifest; 2) add perf profile YAMLs and baseline benchmark results; 3) add changelog automation template and pipeline hook; each commit focused and described in individual messages
